Main uses published nativeapi 0.5.6 media tap/AppKit support. Final real Flutter AOT passed 14 checks, including empty-modifier Physical/Logical Play/Pause in both scopes, actual global tap creation, down/up, repeats, shared handlers and cleanup. Core focus/tap/permission-loss regressions pass. Physical media hardware is not certified; global taps require OS access. macOS CI passed; issue closed.
Real macOS/Windows AOT release apps receive non-null physical-key recordings for Shift+A and Shift+Alt+Q.
Independent left/right Shift primary-key registrations and all standalone left/right modifiers are covered. Chord modifier enum entries remain side-agnostic; handlers can filter physicalKeysPressed.
In-app callbacks observe without consuming keys, so the caller can filter by input FocusNode without suppressing text input.
System scope is independent of focus. Background-only reservation is implemented by registering/unregistering on application lifecycle changes.
Recorder uses physical keys and records Shift/Shift+Alt combinations in widget and AOT release tests.
OS-reserved task-switcher/Spotlight combinations are not portable registrations. Explicit failure is preserved and documented; the library must not steal OS reservations.
Standalone Shift is excluded from its own required modifier set and receives both in-app callbacks.
Standalone Control receives both in-app callbacks for Ctrl+mouse selection. System-wide modifier-only observation is not claimed.

Released nativeapi 0.5.6 Portal support and unchanged HotKey API are on main. Final hosted-package Omarchy pure-Wayland AOT passed two launches and four real compositor/Portal activation rounds. Both Linux hosts passed 61 tests and 14 published-library native X11 checks. Working GlobalShortcuts providers/application identity are required; NUC certifies isolated X11, not GNOME Wayland. Closed after verification.
Real release app hides its native window directly inside the in-app callback, shows it and successfully dispatches the next chord and release.
Matching uses the current primary key, and synthesized held-key downs are ignored. AOT probe checks modifier-only input after a chord, window restore and editable focus.
